title: Structure and roof for an architect's own home, Drumcondra
role: Structural steel, second floor and roof structure, built by MF to About Place's drawings
summary: On site now: we are building the new steel frame, second floor and roof structure at the home of architect Ozan Balcik of About Place Architecture + Design, to his own design.
intro: This is Ozan Balcik's own home. Ozan is the architect behind About Place Architecture + Design, and he designed a new rear extension and second floor for the house. We are building the structural package: temporary propping, the ground floor steel frame, the ridge beam, the second floor and the roof structure.
The image below is About Place's design. Progress photos will follow as the work continues.
